other_failure_modes.name: No baseline model comparison
other_failure_modes.description: The agent builds a custom deep learning architecture but fails to establish a baseline with simpler, robust models (like Logistic Regression or LightGBM). On tabular data, simpler models often outperform or match complex neural networks with less risk of overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a highly structured pipeline with robust scaling, imputation, and a sophisticated Context-Gated MLP that utilizes Stochastic Weight Averaging (SWA). However, it exhibits a critical logic error in the correlation-based feature selection that drops both features in a correlated pair, effectively deleting valuable signal. Additionally, the agent fails to evaluate the stochastic neural network across multiple seeds (FM14) and relies on a single metric (FM15) without establishing a simpler baseline model.
